title: aicore config
description: Settings of the aicore extension layer: event delivery, subscriptions, external plugins and instruction overlays.

events.description: How emitted events are delivered to subscribers.

delivery.description: How emit starts delivery: in a detached process, before emit returns, or not at all (events are only journaled).

timeout_seconds.description: Default deadline of one subscriber run, in seconds.

max_attempts.description: Delivery attempts of one event to one subscriber before it is moved to the dead-letter list.

subscriptions.description: Event subscriptions by id. A module subscription declared in unit.json has the id <module>:<name> and can be switched off here.

on.description: Event type patterns the subscription receives (shell-style wildcards, case-sensitive).

run.description: Command of the subscriber as an argument vector; it receives the event on standard input.

plugin.description: Id of a subscriber plugin to call instead of run.

projects.description: Absolute project roots the subscription applies to; empty means every project.

timeout_seconds.description: Deadline of this subscriber run, in seconds; the default is events.timeout_seconds.

enabled.description: Switch the subscription off without removing it.

plugins.description: External plugins by id. A plugin is a program described by an extension manifest.

manifest.description: Path of the extension manifest (extension.json), absolute or starting with ~.

trusted.description: Let the plugin receive secrets and the full environment.

timeout_seconds.description: Deadline of one plugin call, in seconds.

enabled.description: Switch the plugin off without removing it.

overlays.description: Instruction overlays by slot <module>:<slot>: files added to the slot, in layer order.

^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*:[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$.description: Overlay files of the slot; a relative path is resolved from the folder of the config file that lists it.

providers.description: Provider settings. selection (project layer): which provider surfaces (Claude Code, Codex, ...) are rolled out into the project. available (machine, invocation, flags): whether orch may route roles to a provider, independent of selection. The owner of the form is aicore.provider.

contract_version.description: Version of the provider configuration contract the section is written for.

enabled.description: Roll the provider surfaces out into the project.

available.description: Provider availability for routing by provider id. A provider that is not listed is available.

enabled.description: Let orch route roles to the provider; false makes every route on it unavailable (PROVIDER_DISABLED). Delivery of provider surfaces (selection) is not affected.
